purpose: Track the safe migration from one oversized assembled chat surface into real runtime modules without treating the temporary parts mirror as a second source of truth.
rules: chat.ts remains the runtime entry until a module graph proves parity.
chat.ts.parts/** is migration debt, not an additive production surface.
New behavior must prefer Gateway projections over Shell inference.
No new part may exceed the target size unless listed as explicit debt here.
Closure requires counterpart_paths=0 and duplicate_loc_estimate=0 in the duplicate-surface inventory.
